title: xDrip+ gets "zero slope calibration"  when calibrating through the add treatment dialog
symptom: When adding a BG through the add treatment dialog, the user gets the "got zero slope calibration" error. The error is intermittent, sometimes working through the treatment panel.
cause: A concurrency issue in the code caused the error.
fix: The developer identified and eliminated the code causing the concurrency issue; the fix will be in the next nightly build.
evidence_quote: Its down to a concurrency issue which is why it sometimes happens and mostly doesn't. The fix will be in the next nightly.
